description: Searches hotels and other places to stay by city or country and check-in/check-out dates, with optional filters for brand, room type, maximum nightly rate, star rating and amenities. Results come from LiteAPI, WebBeds and hotels contracted directly with Autonomad, and include nightly and total rates, room options, the cancellation policy, a photo and whether each result can be booked. Every star level is included, ranked best first (guest score or star rating, then price); a hotel whose star rating is unknown has `stars` null. If the person wants only higher-rated hotels, pass min_star_rating (hotels with an unknown rating are then left out and counted in meta.unrated_excluded); if they want the cheapest first, pass flexible: true. Searching does not reserve anything or charge anyone.

amenities.description: Required amenities (wifi, gym, pool, spa, restaurant, etc.)

brand.description: Hotel brand name to filter by

destination_iata.description: IATA code of the airport the traveller flies into (e.g. 'LAS'). Pass it whenever a flight is known: it decides which same-named city is meant (Las Vegas NV vs NM).

flexible.description: true: order results cheapest first instead of best first.

latitude.description: Latitude of the destination, when known.

longitude.description: Longitude of the destination, when known.

min_star_rating.description: Minimum star rating (1-5). Hotels whose rating is unknown are left out and counted in meta.unrated_excluded.

place.description: The exact place of this trip stop: the `place` an earlier search for the trip returned, or the candidate the person picked when a search asked which place they meant. Searches given the same place cover the same place.

airports.description: IATA codes of the airports serving the place.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (territories use their own, e.g. PR).

label.description: How to name the place to the person, e.g. 'Birmingham, GB'.

region.description: State / region of the city (e.g. 'NV', 'Nevada', 'Maine'), when known.

name: search_hotels
